entities.name: House of Fentesk
entities.description: One of the five Houses in Estark, colored orange, whose fighters are associated with red and white mana.

entities.name: Estark
entities.description: City in Kush that holds the five Houses.

entities.name: Varnel Buckara
entities.description: Master of House Fentesk from before the Night of Fire until the Time of Troubles.

entities.name: Varena
entities.description: One of the House's most elite fighters who became Grand Master of the Arena.

entities.name: Okmark
entities.description: A Fentesk fighter who died in an illegal street duel with Garth One-eye.

entities.name: Garth One-eye
entities.description: Killed Okmark in an illegal street duel.

entities.name: Petrakov
entities.description: A merciless Fentesk fighter who killed Farnin of Bolk and Farnin's lover.

entities.name: Farnin of Bolk
entities.description: A fighter of Bolk killed by Petrakov.
